```plato

    //==
    // # Triply periodic minimal surfaces
    //
    // The nodal implicits, each a short trigonometric sum whose zero level set
    // approximates a minimal surface repeating in all three axes
    // (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Triply_periodic_minimal_surface). They are
    // ordinary spatial scalar fields, so the marching cubes and sphere-tracing
    // paths already in the tree consume them unchanged.
    //
    // Turning one into a DISTANCE takes a Lipschitz bound: dividing an implicit
    // by an upper bound on its gradient magnitude gives a value that never
    // exceeds the true distance to its zero set, which is the LOWER BOUND
    // fidelity `implicit-sdf.concepts.plato` describes. Each bound below is the
    // summed coefficient of one partial derivative, lifted to all three by a
    // factor of the square root of three and scaled by the angular frequency.
    // They are honest bounds, not tight ones — the gyroid's is twice its true
    // maximum — so a sphere tracer takes short steps and never steps through.

    // The angular frequency of a period: one full cycle of the trigonometric
    // argument per Period of world distance. Precondition: period is positive.
    TpmsFrequency(period: Number): Number
        => Number.Tau / period;

    // The raw nodal implicit of a family at a point, in the family's own
    // unitless scale. Zero on the surface, and of opposite sign in the two
    // labyrinths it separates.
    TpmsNodalValue(family: TpmsFamily, period: Number, p: Point3D): Number
    {
        var k = TpmsFrequency(period);
        var x = p.X * k;
        var y = p.Y * k;
        var z = p.Z * k;
        return match (family) {
            Gyroid => x.Sin * y.Cos + y.Sin * z.Cos + z.Sin * x.Cos;
            SchwarzPrimitive => x.Cos + y.Cos + z.Cos;
            SchwarzDiamond => x.Sin * y.Sin * z.Sin + x.Sin * y.Cos * z.Cos
                            + x.Cos * y.Sin * z.Cos + x.Cos * y.Cos * z.Sin;
            Neovius => 3.0 * (x.Cos + y.Cos + z.Cos) + 4.0 * x.Cos * y.Cos * z.Cos;
            IwpSurface => 2.0 * (x.Cos * y.Cos + y.Cos * z.Cos + z.Cos * x.Cos)
                        - ((2.0 * x).Cos + (2.0 * y).Cos + (2.0 * z).Cos);
        };
    }

    // The largest magnitude the partial derivative of a family's nodal implicit
    // can reach with respect to ONE scaled coordinate: the sum of its terms'
    // coefficients, since every factor is a sine or cosine bounded by one.
    TpmsPartialBound(family: TpmsFamily): Number
        => match (family) {
            Gyroid => 2.0;
            SchwarzPrimitive => 1.0;
            SchwarzDiamond => 4.0;
            Neovius => 7.0;
            IwpSurface => 6.0;
        };

    // A Lipschitz constant for a family at a period: the three partials bounded
    // together, times the angular frequency. Dividing the nodal value by this
    // turns it into a lower bound on the distance to the surface.
    TpmsGradientBound(family: TpmsFamily, period: Number): Number
        => TpmsPartialBound(family) * 3.0.Sqrt * TpmsFrequency(period);

    // The distance-like value of a family's implicit relative to a level: the
    // nodal value less the level, divided by the family's Lipschitz bound.
    // Negative inside the at-or-below labyrinth. A LOWER BOUND on distance.
    TpmsNormalizedValue(family: TpmsFamily, period: Number, level: Number, p: Point3D): Number
        => (TpmsNodalValue(family, period, p) - level) / TpmsGradientBound(family, period);

    // The nodal implicit shifted so that its zero level set is the field's Level
    // isosurface. Not a distance — the solid types below carry the division that
    // makes one.
    Eval(self: TpmsField3D, point: Point3D): Number
        => TpmsNodalValue(self.Family, self.Period, point) - self.Level;

    // The signed distance to the network solid: negative in the labyrinth where
    // the implicit is at or below Level. A LOWER BOUND, not exact.
    Eval(self: TpmsNetwork3D, point: Point3D): Number
        => TpmsNormalizedValue(self.Family, self.Period, self.Level, point);

    // The signed distance to the sheet solid: negative within half of Thickness
    // of the Level isosurface, on either side of it. A LOWER BOUND, not exact.
    Eval(self: TpmsSheet3D, point: Point3D): Number
        => TpmsNormalizedValue(self.Family, self.Period, self.Level, point).Abs
         - self.Thickness * 0.5;
}
```
